critical_rules: 47 preexisting work IDs reused from exact BWV literal crosswalk across LOTTO45-50; do not create new identities for them.
BWV189 is now attributed to Melchior Hoffmann: historical label in Bach catalog does not imply Bach composition.
BWV36c is a secular original despite its location under sacred cantatas in worklist; keep genre separate.
BWV11 Ascension Oratorio, BWV118 funeral motet, BWV50 single surviving chorus/fragment of uncertain eight-voice version.
BWV156/1 and BWV1056/2 share older lost musical material: do not assert a direct chronology from a source guide.
BWV198 funeral ode to BWV244a and BWV247 reuses require source-specific, non-transitive edges; Flaminio's asserted BWV232 Kyrie link remains unpromoted.
Identical titles in BWV61/62 and BWV20/60 represent distinct works; BWV36/36c distinct despite shared title.
BWV82.1, 82.2, 82.3 refer to versions, not three newly composed works; inherit LOTTO48.

records.editorial_note: Flaminio in intestazione dichiara Bach, ma nello stesso testo menziona attribuzione incerta; catalogo indipendente attribuisce a Melchior Hoffmann. BWV189 = numero storico non certificazione di paternità.
